ratios.covenant_name: maximum permitted leverage ratio (consolidated net leverage, netting up to $150.0 million of unrestricted cash)
ratios.facility: Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (revolving credit facility)
ratios.quote: modify the maximum permitted leverage ratio to include a net debt concept (permitting up to $150.0 million of unrestricted cash to be netted from the calculation thereof), and to provide that such ratio shall be no greater than 4.00 to 1.00 during the first quarter of 2026, and for each fiscal quarter thereafter

parsed.notes: The filing does not give the actual net leverage ratio. It says only that the company was in compliance with all financial covenants as of June 30, 2026. The 4.00x limit can rise to 4.50x for up to four fiscal quarters after a material acquisition. The excerpt does not say whether that step-up applied at June 30, 2026. An interest coverage covenant is mentioned, but no limit or actual figure is given, so it is not listed. The net leverage ratio also sets the pricing margin and commitment fee, but that pricing use is separate from the covenant and is excluded.
